next_edition.label: GO OUT CAMP 冬 2026 with GO OUT JIMNY CAMP 2026

organiser.name: GO OUT CAMP executive committee; planning and production by Sanei (GO OUT) and Earth Garden

audience.psychographics: Winter campers in the GO OUT outdoor fashion orbit; organiser says sub-zero nights mean more expert campers than spring or autumn editions; 2026 adds Suzuki Jimny owners via the co-located GO OUT JIMNY CAMP.

ticket_price.note: 2026 presale with Sierra cup (30 Sep to 12 Nov): Sat day ticket JPY 2,500; 1-night JPY 5,500; 2-night JPY 7,500; with auto-camp parking JPY 9,000 (1-night) to JPY 10,800 (2-night); group sets for 3 people up to JPY 25,800. One ticket covers both Winter and Jimny Camp areas.

add_sources.note: History lists winter editions on 10 to 11 Dec 2016, 16 to 17 Dec 2017, 15 to 16 Dec 2018, 14 to 15 Dec 2019, Christmas Camp 9 to 11 Dec 2022, 8 to 10 Dec 2023 and 13 to 15 Dec 2024.
Google snippet: GO OUT CAMP 冬 2025 scheduled for Fri 12 to Sun 14 Dec 2025.
@goout_camp (30 Sep 2026): winter camp is held again this year ('今年も開催'), 11 to 13 Dec 2026, jointly with GO OUT JIMNY CAMP 2026.
About page: 主催 GO OUT CAMP 実行委員会; 企画・制作 株式会社三栄 GO OUT / アースガーデン; 特別協力 ふもとっぱら.
2022 history entry: winter draws more expert campers ('玄人キャンパーが多い') than spring or autumn because temperatures drop below zero. First winter edition (2016) had just over 300 visitors.

Winter site links a contact form (pro.form-mailer.jp) which Google shows as covering sponsorship and exhibiting enquiries, plus market and food exhibitor forms; IG bio routes all enquiries to info@gooutcamp.jp.

2026 activities: outdoor flea market, street performance, BBQ, yoga, singing night club, balloon rides, message fireworks, treasure-hunt stamp rally; organiser post also mentions workshops and brand booths.
